newsitem.title: USA: Omnicare to acquire Hallmark Medical.
newsitem.headline: Omnicare to acquire Hallmark Medical.

text.p: Omnicare Inc said on Monday it has agreed to acquire Hallmark Medical Co, a privately owned institutional pharmacy provider based in Ridgewood, New Jersey.
Also, Omnicare said it has acquired the assets and business of the long-term care division of Squire Drugs Inc, a privately owned pharmacy provider based in Folcroft, Pennsylvania.

Terms of each deal were not disclosed, but these transactions will add $6.8 million in annual revenues for the company, said Omnicare, a provider of pharmacy and consulting services for long-term care facilities.
The Hallmark Medical transaction is expected to be completed within 30 days.
